name: oar-identity-starter
description: Next.js starter with an OAR App ID and verifiable program, domain and repo links

instructions: An OAR-ready starter is not a registered or verified application.
Edit oar.config.json with your real domain, repository and any deployed program IDs, then prepare identity files from your PUBLIC creator address:
Host the generated files, register on Devnet with your own wallet at https://oarprotocol.xyz/register, and inspect every link's state.
